name: Idol Yukiho no Wan-chan Panic!
original_name: アイドル雪歩のワンちゃんパニック!
source:
Idol Yukiho runs away from a dog and gets abducted by a UFO. Moreover, she is merged with the dog during teleportation. She gets cute dog ears, but also beast estrus. Main character is her producer who needs to promote her as idol with dog ears and also deal with her intimate problem.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-december-2008-428-fuusa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
偶像萩原雪步为躲一只狗而逃跑，却被UFO劫走；传送过程中，她还与那只狗融合在了一起。她长出可爱的狗耳，同时也出现了野兽般的发情症状。主人公是她的制作人，既要把狗耳偶像雪步推向市场，也要设法解决她的私密烦恼。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-december-2008-428-fuusa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
